result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe** as the best all-around payment processor. However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses and where your customers are located.

Since you're in Canada, I'd narrow the choices to these four\:

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![CardPaymentOptions.com – Merchant account and credit card processing reviews, ratings, and comparisons. Find the best merchant services provider for your business here.](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZyZx-kGJMZw-frY74Lp0ngbxxLn259SUwCVVGOs1w20aKyIMId6L9a8Lefu8zLlMx7xnfJ4MU7qPcSfFbO5tVAgdPB1Khq5kNSJbYx1vk3M83mq8t33NR3qOgnaDJXn_nY49IEKKDAg_eN4eUQrXqatPrzUusxUBWQPGwHzhUeEf4Nh96ZP9rKyCEo6DL8AI?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- Accepts major credit and debit cards.
- Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent subscription and recurring payment options.
- No monthly processing fee on standard pay-as-you-go pricing.

Website: [Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and order management.
- Supports Shop Pay and major cards.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

Website: [Shopify Payments Canada](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best as an additional option)

- Many customers already trust it.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance.
- Supports credit and debit cards.
- Easy to add to existing stores.

Website: [PayPal Business Canada](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Helcim**

(Worth comparing for lower fees)

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly processing subscription.
- Particularly worth considering as sales volume grows.

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com/)

These are not identical pricing structures, so compare the actual Canadian rates before signing up. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Growing store with significant sales\:** Compare Helcim's interchange-plus pricing.
